top_signals.title: India Regulator Orders Options Trainer Avadhut Sathe to Refund INR 5.46B
top_signals.summary: India’s market regulator has ordered options trader Avadhut Sathe and his trading academy to refund 5.46 billion rupees ($57.5 million) to course participants after finding they provided unregistered investment advice and research services under the guise of stock market education.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
